objective: Draft a minimal Docker-on-Ubuntu-WSL HPC-2 profile for review, with per-job privileges, channels, mounts, limits, existing-workload protection and preflight gates, without executable deployment artifacts.
request_basis: User requested proceed after Docker in Ubuntu was verified and a minimal profile review was proposed before any synthetic container execution. This authorizes documentation maintenance, not container create/start, image pull/build, Docker/WSL configuration, daemon restart, existing-workload modification or product GO.
acceptance: Record prior Ubuntu/Docker survey with temporal and evidence limits; do not confuse Windows CLI discovery with Docker availability, systemd status with daemon reachability, or virtual disk capacity with physical free storage.

Propose a non-root no-socket no-host-mount network-none bounded synthetic profile; map concrete Docker controls to contract requirements with authoritative documentation, marking unsupported/unknown controls.

Separate packet/proposal/log channels and supervisor authority; account for hidden image defaults, mutable tags, daemon log growth, cgroup v1 limitations, termination and exact-ID cleanup without providing a runnable launcher.

Protect existing workloads on the shared daemon; no restart/prune/stop existing containers or implicit upgrade; keep image/runtime provenance, independent observers and explicit execution review pending.
Only five docs outputs change after baseline; preserve runtime/code/tests/state/plan/data and ASTRA, keep HB tests NOT RUN, and run fixed harness/structure checks with local data integrity.
